# Custom City Map Blanket, Personalized Blanket, Map, Housewarming Gift, Gift For Him, Home Decor, Birthday Gift, Best Friend Gifts, City Map

[cozyloftdesigns](https://www.etsy.com/shop/cozyloftdesigns?ref=shop-header-name&listing_id=1016338618&from_page=listing)  

Star Seller

Star Sellers have an outstanding track record for providing a great customer experience—they consistently earned 5-star reviews, shipped orders on time, and replied quickly to any messages they received.

[5 out of 5 stars](#reviews)

## Item highlights

- Materials: Cotton
- Made to order

## Seller's description

Whether you are shopping for a home town hero or a fellow traveler our custom city map blanket makes the perfect personalized gift. This personalized map blanket makes an ideal housewarming gift, gift for him, gift for her, Best friend Gift, or Birthday gift. This custom woven throw can be personalized with any city map. Both Domestic or International can be done. NYC, LA, Dallas, Atlanta, Philly, Boston, Paris, Tokyo, Hong Kong, London, Amsterdam, Berlin, Rome, etc.. Just reach out and let me know.

ABOUT US:

Hi and welcome to our shop! Our hope is that our products will help you share the love of family and friendship while bringing a little bit of warmth and comfort into your home. Like a great hug, or a snuggly pet, a cozy blanket can warm both hand and heart.

CUSTOMIZATION:

Every blanket is designed with love and made with 100% cotton. Each blanket is custom woven to order in the USA. Blankets will have slight variances in color due to the nature of the production method and availability of yarn (solid colored yarn, combined with black and white yarn are used to create the final product).

------------------

For this blanket, please include in the additional text box:

The city you would like to be featured as well as the color of the weave (brown or black).

------------------

PROCESSING TIME:

After submitting your custom order, please allow us up to 48 hours to send you a proof. Once the proof is approved, we will send the design off to be woven by our wonderful production partner! Please allow 5-8 business days for production. *During the busy holiday season, production may take closer to 10 business days.

If we do not hear back from you within 3 days from when the first proof is sent, the blanket will be made according to the proof. No additional changes can be made past the 3-day mark.

There may be additional delivery days due to current irregularities in USPS time frame estimates.

## Seller's description

Whether you are shopping for a home town hero or a fellow traveler our custom city map blanket makes the perfect personalized gift. This personalized map blanket makes an ideal housewarming gift, gift for him, gift for her, Best friend Gift, or Birthday gift. This custom woven throw can be personalized with any city map. Both Domestic or International can be done. NYC, LA, Dallas, Atlanta, Philly, Boston, Paris, Tokyo, Hong Kong, London, Amsterdam, Berlin, Rome, etc.. Just reach out and let me know.

ABOUT US:

Hi and welcome to our shop! Our hope is that our products will help you share the love of family and friendship while bringing a little bit of warmth and comfort into your home. Like a great hug, or a snuggly pet, a cozy blanket can warm both hand and heart.

CUSTOMIZATION:

Every blanket is designed with love and made with 100% cotton. Each blanket is custom woven to order in the USA. Blankets will have slight variances in color due to the nature of the production method and availability of yarn (solid colored yarn, combined with black and white yarn are used to create the final product).

------------------

For this blanket, please include in the additional text box:

The city you would like to be featured as well as the color of the weave (brown or black).

------------------

PROCESSING TIME:

After submitting your custom order, please allow us up to 48 hours to send you a proof. Once the proof is approved, we will send the design off to be woven by our wonderful production partner! Please allow 5-8 business days for production. *During the busy holiday season, production may take closer to 10 business days.

If we do not hear back from you within 3 days from when the first proof is sent, the blanket will be made according to the proof. No additional changes can be made past the 3-day mark.

There may be additional delivery days due to current irregularities in USPS time frame estimates.
